activeShare.assertionSource: hardcoded true in privacy-probe.mjs, not a measured test; public names are separately observed in matrix metadata

anonymousCollectionPage.classification: unresolved aggregate; route/Flight ID is compatible with source and marker set, but raw body and private state were removed before class/location isolation

limitations: No production hostname, deployment, Search Console, or human domain approval was used.
No full page HTML, cookies, password, token, email, or real user data was retained in this report.
Hydrated DOM is recorded separately after browser inspection.
notes: Build output restored webpack; this does not count as Turbopack green.
Fallback canonical https://pokescan.app is build output only; production domain approval remains pending.
No private account values, access tokens, passwords, cookie values, or raw HTML are included. Synthetic price fixture was cache-only and is not market evidence.
Noindex metadata measures indexing directives only; it does not establish route authentication.

Collection marker observations use different marker sets; the positive additional aggregate cannot retrospectively distinguish route/Flight identifiers from protected content. Noindex does not establish privacy.
runWindow records core HTTP/API only; site resources, DOM and privacy probe were later phases.
Error 503 is a proxy-controlled scenario with normal UA only, not a backend outage or all-UA coverage.
No status/metadata/body hash or observed boolean was changed; hardcoded display assertion was relabeled and provenance/limits added.
Build output is not invariant: independent comparison finds 10 changed existing hashes, 4 cache additions, no missing files, same Build ID.

coreHttpApi.scope: core HTTP route/user-agent matrix plus API summary only; later phases have their own capturedAt

observationProvenance.http: producer fetch response.status and selected headers; manual redirect handling; browser-independent core matrix
observationProvenance.headInitial: first completed literal <head> section assembled while reading the stream, not first chunk or time-to-first-byte
observationProvenance.documentCompleteMetadata: regex extraction of literal title/meta/link tags in complete HTML; not an executed DOM or separately classified Flight payload
observationProvenance.bodyHashes: SHA-256 of full received body; raw body removed, cannot independently reinspect or recompute now
observationProvenance.corePrivateMarkerPresent: substring any-of email, username, password, passwordHash, fixed legacy private-note sentinel; not an exhaustive leak test
observationProvenance.apiBodyHasPrivateMarker: substring any-of email, password, passwordHash, fixed legacy private-note sentinel; differs from HTML marker set
observationProvenance.privacyProbe: additional substring any-of credentials/username, user/collection/item IDs, passwordHash/refreshToken/accessToken field names, legacy private-note sentinel; aggregate only, no matched class/location
observationProvenance.domHydration: producer browser inspection summaries for three cases; supplied DOM summary hashes have no retained canonical hashing algorithm or raw DOM for independent recomputation
observationProvenance.userAgents: normal desktop Chromium string, Googlebot Smartphone string and Twitterbot/1.0 supplied by harness; not real crawlers or a mobile normal UA
observationProvenance.assertions: expected synthetic public display in privacy-probe was hardcoded true; not a measured assertion result
observationProvenance.fixtureScope: synthetic fixture states set before captures; no new revoke/expire after cache warming, no seeded private notes and no authenticated/foreign collection API privacy probe

externalFetchObservation.mechanism: globalThis.fetch monkey patch via NODE_OPTIONS in launched backend/frontend/fixture Node processes; only loopback allowed
externalFetchObservation.harnessCounting: log line count, missing log treated as zero by audit.mjs
limitations: Does not instrument arbitrary network APIs or all transports.
Temporary log removed; independent reviewer cannot reconstruct zero attempts.
externalFetchObservation.providerPolicy: no direct provider call was introduced; queue/crons disabled; synthetic cache-only prices
